baseline.scope_note: Frozen historical161-match baseline. The lead subsequently promoted exact StoreVectorExec in e9f63e9, increasing canonical coverage to162; no current source or coverage metadata is overwritten here.

reason: Native multiply and LoadVector were independently solved through decoder declaration order. Earlier native arithmetic evidence had only one full-unit four-field order and six three-field orders in an early isolated fixture.

method.preserved: All175 other function bodies,161 previously exact complete functions,25 typed data objects and11 typed overlapping fields remain identical in all29 mutated source controls. All native relocation operands resolve.
method.cached_element_family: All24 permutations of vd/vs/vt/element, with element decoded once before the fast path and mask expressions rewritten through that local. This family changes selector representation as well as declaration order. VSUBExec retains the observed global-instruction selector; VADDExec uses its argument.
method.independent_selector_family: All six orders of vd/vs/vt, including the unmodified fresh baseline, preserving existing independent >>22 and >>21 selector formulas and every other source expression.

assembly_findings: All24 cached-element permutations make every arithmetic body16 or32 bytes shorter than the original. They do not reproduce the native helper selector setup; for example original VADDExec independently derives the >>22 table index and >>21 element after its fast-path branch, while the cached-element control computes the masked element before that branch and derives the index from it.

All six independent-selector declaration orders preserve original function extents. Every one still enters the main arithmetic loop with selector-mask/offset loads. Each original begins the loop with the lane shift-count LEA, MOV EAX,1, SHL EAX,CL and carry flag extraction. Thus declaration order alone does not recover the shared arithmetic dataflow.

VADD with vt/vs/vd order has one newly exact original17-byte basic block at relative offsets63..80 in the fast-path condition. No new complete arithmetic-loop basic block is exact in the five pure reorder candidates. This small prefix improvement is not promoted while the shared loop remains unexplained.
decision: Retain canonical source. No complete function becomes exact, and neither family fixes the common carry-before-selector schedule. No type, lifetime, qualifier, helper, instruction or binary-output changes are promoted.
behavior: No rejected candidate was promoted or claimed behavior-validated. Existing canonical behavior evidence is unchanged.
limitations: These controls exclude the tested declaration orders within the reconstructed expression forms; they do not prove original source spelling.
The cached-element and independent-selector families are separate hypotheses and must not be conflated.
Complete-function equality, data identity and whole-DLL layout remain separate claims.
